Davide anati: Ine ndimakukondani Inu Yehova, mphamvu zanga.
Yehova ndiye thanthwe langa, chitetezo changa ndi mpulumutsi wanga;
Mulungu wanga ndi thanthwe langa mʼmene ndimathawiramo.
Chishango changa ndi ndodo yachipulumutso changa, ndi linga langa.
Ndimayitana Yehova amene ndi woyenera matamando,
Anandimanga ndi zingwe za ku manda;
ndinalirira kwa Mulungu wanga kuti andithandize.
Ali mʼNyumba yake, anamva mawu anga;
kulira kwanga kunafika pamaso pake ndi mʼmakutu mwake.

makala amoto anali lawilawi mʼkamwa mwake.

Mʼkuwala kumene kunali pamaso pake munkachokera matalala,
Iye anaponya mivi yake nabalalitsa adani ake,
maziko a dziko lapansi anakhala poyera,

adani anga, amene anali amphamvu kuposa ine.

molingana ndi makhalidwe anga abwino, Iye wandipulumutsa.

ndilibe mlandu wochoka pamaso Mulungu wanga.
Malamulo ake onse ali pamaso panga;

Mayiko akumwamba ndi anu ndiponso dziko lapansi ndi lanu;
munapanga dziko lonse ndi zonse zili mʼmenemo.
Tabori ndi Herimoni akuyimba ndi chimwemwe pa dzina lanu.
dzanja lanu ndi lamphamvu, dzanja lanu lamanja ndi lopambana.
Chilungamo ndi chiweruzo cholungama ndiye maziko a mpando wanu waufumu;
chikondi ndi kukhulupirika zimayenda patsogolo panu.
Ndi odala amene aphunzira kuyamika Inu,
amene amayenda mʼkuwunika kwa nkhope yanu Yehova.
Amakondwera mʼdzina lanu tsiku lonse lathunthu;
Pakuti Inu ndiye ulemerero wawo ndi mphamvu yawo
ndipo mwa kukoma mtima kwanu Inu mumakweza nyanga yathu.
Ndithudi, chishango chathu ndi cha Yehova,
Mfumu yathu kwa Woyerayo wa Israeli.
ndakweza mnyamata wochokera pakati pa anthu.
ndipo kudzera mʼdzina langa nyanga yake idzakwezedwa.
Iyeyo adzafuwula kwa Ine kuti, 'Ndinu Atate anga,
Mulungu wanga, Thanthwe ndi Chipulumutso changa.'
Ndidzamuyika kuti akhale mwana wanga woyamba kubadwa;
wokwezedwa kwambiri pakati pa mafumu a dziko lapansi.
ndipo pangano langa ndi iye silidzatha.
Ine ndidzakhazikitsa zidzukulu zake mpaka muyaya,
mpando wake waufumu ngati masiku a miyamba.
Ine ndidzalanga tchimo lawo ndi ndodo,
Koma sindidzachotsa chikondi changa pa iye,
kapena kusintha zimene milomo yanga yayankhula.
ndipo mpando wake waufumu udzakhazikika pamaso panga ngati dzuwa;
ndipo mwadetsa mʼfumbi chipewa chake chaufumu.
Onse amene amadutsa amalanda zinthu zake;
iye wakhala chotonzedwa cha anansi ake.
Mwakweza dzanja lamanja la adani ake;
Inu mwathetsa kukongola kwa ulemerero wake
ndipo mwagwetsa pansi mpando wake waufumu.
"Mpaka liti Yehova? Kodi mudzadzibisa mpaka kalekale?
Mpaka liti ukali wanu udzayaka ngati moto?
Kumbukirani kuti masiku a moyo wanga ndi ochepa
Kodi ndi munthu uti angakhale ndi moyo ndi kusaona imfa?
Kapena kudzipulumutsa yekha ku mphamvu ya manda?
Inu Ambuye kodi chili kuti chikondi chanu chachikulu choyamba chija,
chimene mwa kukhulupirika kwanu munalumbira kwa Davide?
Kumbukirani, Ambuye momwe mtumiki wanu wanyozedwera,
momwe ndakhalira ndi kusunga mu mtima mwanga mawu a pangano a anthu a mitundu yonse,
mawu achipongwe amene adani anu akhala akunyoza, Inu Yehova,
ndi mawu amene akhala akunyoza mayendedwe onse a wodzozedwa wanu.

items.text: Pemphero la Mose munthu wa Mulungu.
Ambuye, mwakhala muli malo athu okhalamo
musanalenge nʼkomwe dziko lapansi ndi dziko lonse,
kuyambira muyaya mpaka muyaya Inu ndinu Mulungu.
mumati, "Bwerera ku fumbi iwe mwana wa munthu."
Inu mumasesa anthu mʼtulo ta imfa,
iwo ali ngati udzu watsopano wa mmawa,
machimo athu obisika poonekera pamaso panu.
Masiku athu onse amatha ali pansi pa ukali wanu;
komabe zaka zonsezi ndi za mavuto ndi nkhawa,
zimatha mofulumira ndipo ife timawulukira kutali.
Kodi ndani amadziwa mphamvu ya mkwiyo wanu?
Pakuti ukali wanu ndi waukulu ngati ulemu umene uyenera Inu.
Lezani mtima Inu Yehova! Kodi mudzatikwiyira mpaka liti?
Mutikhutitse mmawa ndi chikondi chanu chosatha,
kuti tiyimbe ndi chimwemwe ndi kukhala okondwa masiku athu onse.
Tisangalatseni masiku ambiri monga masiku amene mwatisautsa,
kwa zaka zambiri monga momwe tinaonera mavuto.
Ntchito zanu zionetsedwe kwa atumiki anu,
Kukoma mtima kwa Ambuye Mulungu wathu kukhale pa ife;
inde, khazikitsani ntchito ya manja athu.

mfumu yayikulu pamwamba pa milungu yonse.

tiyeni tigwade pamaso pa Yehova Mlengi wathu;

Ulemu ndi ufumu zili pamaso pake,

kulira kwanga kopempha thandizo kufike kwa Inu.
Pakuti masiku anga akupita ngati utsi;
mafupa anga akunyeka ngati nkhuni zoyaka.
Mtima wanga wakanthidwa ndipo ukufota ngati udzu;
Ndili ngati kadzidzi wa ku chipululu,

Tsiku lonse adani anga amandichita chipongwe;
iwo amene amandinyoza, amagwiritsa ntchito dzina langa ngati temberero.
Pakuti ndimadya phulusa ngati chakudya changa
ndi kusakaniza chakumwa changa ndi misozi
popeza Inu mwandinyamula ndi kunditayira kumbali.
Masiku anga ali ngati mthunzi wa kumadzulo;
Koma Inu Yehova, muli pa mpando wanu waufumu kwamuyaya;

Pakuti miyala yake ndi yokondedwa kwa atumiki anu;
fumbi lake lokha limawachititsa kuti amve chisoni.

mafumu onse a dziko lapansi adzalemekeza ulemerero wanu.
